_about: Claude base case: researched default assumptions per ticker. They sit on top of the automatic Damodaran/Yahoo defaults, and your own edits on the dashboard sit on top of these. Rates are decimals (0.18 = 18%). Only rates and multiples are set here; revenue, cash, debt and shares still come from the twice-daily data refresh. Keys under base/bear/bull are valuation input names (see web/src/lib/valuation/fields.ts).

NOW.summary: Category leader in IT/enterprise workflow; Q3 2026 subscription revenue +21%, FY26 guide +22.5%, AI ACV target raised to $1.7B. Growth slowly decelerates; GAAP margin rises as stock-based pay shrinks relative to revenue.

rationale.growthHigh: Q3 2026 subscription growth 21% and cRPO +20.5%; assume ~18% average over 5 years as the base gets larger.
rationale.targetMargin: Non-GAAP operating margin is ~32%, GAAP ~10-15% because of stock-based pay; a mature GAAP margin of ~28% treats that pay as a real cost.
rationale.salesToCapital: Asset-light software; mostly capitalised R&D and data centres.
rationale.exitMultiple: 35x year-5 earnings: still ~10%+ growth then, in line with large-cap software quality names.

IREN.summary: Ex-bitcoin miner pivoting to AI cloud (GPU rental). Q1 FY27 revenue $228M, ~$1B operating ARR, $20B backlog, >$4B ARR target slipped to early 2027, ~$20B capex plan funded with debt. Very high growth but very capital-hungry and execution-risky. Note: even with these assumptions the DCF comes out well below the price, because the debt already taken on is large relative to today's revenue. The price is a bet on the ramp; use the bull case and the 5-year target to judge it.

rationale.growthHigh: From under $1B trailing revenue to the $4B+ ARR target in early 2027, then slower growth on a $20B backlog: ~55% a year averages out the front-loaded ramp.
rationale.targetMargin: GPU cloud operating margin after heavy depreciation; peers (CoreWeave) run ~20-30%.
rationale.marginConvergenceYear: Margin reaches steady state once contracted clusters are running (about year 4).
rationale.salesToCapital: Headline capex is ~$20B, but much of the current build is already financed by the ~$10B of debt on the balance sheet, so each new $1 of capital supports ~$1 of extra revenue.
rationale.failureProbability: 10%: large debt-funded build-out, customer concentration and GPU obsolescence risk.
rationale.distressProceeds: Data centres and power sites keep some value in a distress sale.
rationale.exitMultiple: 18x: capital-intensive infrastructure earnings deserve a lower multiple than software.
rationale.waccInitial: ~12%: high-beta stock (~2) on a 4.5% equity risk premium, blended with ~8% secured GPU financing. The automatic figure is higher because trailing losses give a poor synthetic credit rating.

VST.summary: Largest US competitive power producer (gas + nuclear) with retail arm; benefits from data-centre power demand and nuclear PPAs; strong buybacks.

rationale.growthHigh: Power prices and data-centre contracts lift revenue ~7% a year; generation is a mature business.
rationale.targetMargin: Recent operating margin ~20-23% with hedged gross margin rising; 24% assumes long-term contracts at higher prices.
rationale.salesToCapital: Power plants are capital-heavy; ~$1 of new revenue per $1 invested.
rationale.exitMultiple: 18x year-5 earnings: a premium to old utilities (~15x) for contracted data-centre growth.

CEG.summary: Largest US nuclear fleet, plus Calpine gas fleet (acquired 2026). Long-term nuclear PPAs with hyperscalers (Microsoft, Meta) give visible, inflation-linked earnings growth.

rationale.growthHigh: Calpine adds scale; nuclear contract re-pricing plus uprates give ~9% revenue growth.
rationale.targetMargin: Nuclear is high-margin, gas and retail lower; blended ~22%.
rationale.exitMultiple: 20x: scarce carbon-free baseload with 20-year contracts trades at a premium to other power producers.

SOFI.summary: Digital bank (lending, deposits, Galileo tech platform). Q3 2026 revenue +44%, 17.1M members. FY26 guide: ~$840M net income; 2027 guide: ~$6.4B revenue and ~$1.28B net income (20% margin), adjusted EPS ~$0.90.

rationale.roeCurrent: 2027 net income guide ~$1.28B on roughly $10-11B of equity gives ~12%; rises as revenue grows faster than capital.
rationale.roeStable: Mature digital bank with low branch costs earns a little more than the ~11-12% bank average.
rationale.payoutRatio: No dividend; all earnings retained to grow the loan book.
rationale.exitMultiple: 20x year-5 earnings: above banks (~11-13x) for 20%+ growth, below fintech platforms.

FPS.summary: Forgent Power Solutions: US maker of electrical distribution gear (switchgear, transformers) for data centres and utilities. FY26 (Jun) revenue $1.42B, +89%; FY27 guide $2.4-2.6B (+76%); backlog $3.0B (+256%); capacity to ~$5.8B after 2027 expansion.

rationale.growthHigh: FY27 guide +76%, then slows as capacity (~$5.8B) fills; ~32% average over 5 years reaches ~$6B revenue.
rationale.targetMargin: Q4 FY26 GAAP operating margin ~20%, adjusted EBITDA margin ~24%; assume ~19% through the cycle.
rationale.salesToCapital: Factory expansions are modest relative to sales; ~$2.5 revenue per $1 invested.
rationale.failureProbability: Recently IPO'd with debt, but strong backlog; small risk.
rationale.exitMultiple: 25x: electrical equipment peers (Eaton, Vertiv, Powell) trade ~25-35x, discounted for cyclicality by year 5.

ATAT.summary: Atour: Chinese mid-to-upscale hotel franchisor with a fast-growing retail (sleep products) arm. Asset-light, high cash returns, pays dividends; China consumer and country risk apply.

rationale.growthHigh: Hotel openings (~20% a year) plus retail growing faster; ~15% blended as the base grows.
rationale.targetMargin: Current operating margin ~22%; franchise model keeps it there.
rationale.salesToCapital: Franchisees fund most hotels, so little capital is needed.
rationale.exitMultiple: 15x: China consumer names trade at a discount to US peers for country risk.

GRAB.summary: Southeast Asia super-app (rides, food delivery, fintech). Turned GAAP-profitable in 2025; growing ~20% with margins expanding; large net cash.

rationale.growthHigh: Revenue growth ~20% now (deliveries, mobility, lending); ~17% average over 5 years.
rationale.targetMargin: Uber's operating margin is heading to mid-teens; Grab follows with lower prices in its markets.
rationale.marginConvergenceYear: Margin expansion is gradual, reaching target around year 6.
rationale.exitMultiple: 28x: still growing double digits in year 5, similar to Uber/DoorDash on forward earnings.

SE.summary: Sea Ltd: Shopee (SE Asia + Brazil e-commerce), Monee (digital finance) and Garena (games). Revenue growing ~25-35%, profitable with margins expanding.

rationale.growthHigh: Shopee GMV and ads plus Monee lending growth; ~18% average as growth slows from today's pace.
rationale.targetMargin: MercadoLibre earns ~12-15% operating margin; Sea gets there as Shopee ads take-rate rises.
rationale.exitMultiple: 25x: double-digit grower with e-commerce and fintech, in line with MercadoLibre-type names.

MSTR.summary: Strategy (MicroStrategy) is a bitcoin treasury company: almost all value is the bitcoin it holds minus debt and preferred stock. A revenue DCF doesn't capture this. Value it as bitcoin holdings x BTC price, minus debt and preferred, divided by diluted shares; then compare to the share price (mNAV).

BMNR.summary: BitMine is an ether treasury company: value is mostly its ETH (plus cash) minus liabilities. A revenue DCF doesn't capture this. Value it as ETH holdings x ETH price plus cash, divided by shares; then compare to the share price (mNAV).

AAPL.summary: Mature consumer hardware plus a high-margin services business; huge buybacks.

rationale.growthHigh: iPhone cycles plus ~12% services growth: ~6% blended.
rationale.targetMargin: Services mix pushes operating margin slightly above today's ~31%.
rationale.exitMultiple: 26x: quality premium, in line with its 5-year average.

D05.SI.summary: DBS: Singapore's largest bank, high ROE, generous dividends; earnings ease as interest rates fall.

rationale.roeCurrent: ROE ~17% recently; falling rates trim it to ~16%.
rationale.roeStable: Long-run ROE for a top Asian bank.
rationale.payoutRatio: Ordinary plus capital-return dividends ~60% of earnings.

0700.HK.summary: Tencent: WeChat, games, ads, fintech and cloud; steady double-digit profit growth and buybacks.

rationale.growthHigh: Games, ads (AI targeting) and payments: ~9% revenue growth.
rationale.targetMargin: Operating margin ~33% and rising as high-margin ads and games grow.
rationale.exitMultiple: 18x: China discount to US platform peers.
